attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 28, `rpmD` to `yhdV`, are carried by 94 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 1% of calls. The model names 89 to 100% of them, fewest at column 24, `yhdZ`, 89%.

**A short variable stretch follows**, columns 29 to 31, `acrF` to `acrS`, carried by 86 to 90%, [[multidrug efflux]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 98 against 91%, and hesitates less there, 0.11 against 0.35 bits. It hesitates most at column 30, `acrE`, a variable column, 0.64 bits.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Columns 71 to 79, `nanK` to `mtgA`, are carried by 30 to 90%, the stretch most in regions of plasticity, 5 to 35%. The last column is `mtgA`, in 30% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 97% of genes**, 0.15 bits on average, perplexity 1.2 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.80 against 0.11 bits, and names fewer genes, 70% against 98%.

label: rpmD
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the rpmD window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor rpmD, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 416 to 495 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying rpmD once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 97% of genes, 0.15 bits on average (perplexity 1.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 38,920 calls, named 99%, 0.08 bits; shell 3,964 calls, named 76%, 0.65 bits; cloud 236 calls, named 40%, 2.22 bits. Outside an RGP 40,848 calls, named 98%, 0.11 bits; inside an RGP 2,272 calls, named 70%, 0.80 bits. Columns: 67 spine, 7 fork, 6 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.80 against 0.11 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 98%); 2,272 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 30 (acrE, a variable column) 0.64 bits, RGP 2%; column 73 (yhcG, a fork column) 0.60 bits, RGP 30%; column 29 (acrF, a variable column) 0.55 bits, RGP 2%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 67 spine columns: named 98%, 0.11 bits on average; the 13 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.35 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 30, is a variable column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 71-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 5-35%; the least: columns 0-28 (spine), RGP 0-1%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-28 (29 columns) spine: share 94-100%, all P, RGP 0-1%. Genes: rpmD, rplO, secY, rpmJ, rpsM, rpsK, rpsD "30S ribosomal protein S4", rpoA, rplQ, yhdN "DUF1992 domain-containing protein", zntR, arfA, mscL, trkA, rsmB, fmt, def, dprA, smg, yrdD "DNA topoisomerase family protein", tsaC, aroE, yrdB "DUF1488 domain-containing protein", yrdA "gamma carbonic anhydrase family pro…", yhdZ "amino acid ABC transporter ATP-bind…", yhdY "amino acid ABC transporter permease", yhdX "amino acid ABC transporter permease", yhdW "amino acid ABC transporter substrat…", yhdV "membrane protein". named 89-100% (mean 99%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 24 (yhdZ), named 89%, 0.54 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 29-31 (3 columns) variable: share 86-90%, 2 S, 1 P, RGP 2%. named 91-94% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 29, named 91%; most hesitant at column 30, 0.64 bits.
[S2.c29]    29: acrF S 86% "multidrug efflux RND transporter pe…"
[S2.c30]    30: acrE S 89%
[S2.c31]    31: acrS P 90%
[S3] 3. columns 32-65 (34 columns) spine: share 92-97%, all P, RGP 1-18%. Genes: yhdU "DUF2556 family protein", yhdJ "adenine-specific DNA-methyltransfer…", fis, dusB, prmA, panF, yhdT "YhdT family protein", accC, accB "acetyl-CoA carboxylase biotin carbo…", yhdH "MDR family oxidoreductase", csrD, mreB "rod shape-determining protein MreB", mreC, mreD, yhdE "nucleoside triphosphate pyrophospha…", rng, yhdP "AsmA2 domain-containing protein YhdP", tldD, aaeR, aaeX "p-hydroxybenzoic acid efflux pump o…", aaeA, aaeB, yhcO "barstar family protein", yhcN "peroxide/acid stress response prote…", argR, mdh, degS "outer membrane-stress sensor serine…", degQ, zapG, zapE "cell division protein ZapE", rplM, rpsI, sspA, sspB "ClpXP protease specificity-enhancin…". named 85-99% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 39 (accC), named 85%; most hesitant at column 41 (yhdH), 0.42 bits.
[S4] 4. column 66 variable: share 81%, all S, RGP 2%. named 96%; 0.21 bits.
[S4.c66]    66: dcuC S 81%
[S5] 5. columns 67-70 (4 columns) spine: share 92-93%, all P, RGP 2-3%. Genes: nanR, nanA "N-acetylneuraminate lyase", nanT, nanE. named 97-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 67 (nanR), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.17 bits (column 67 (nanR)).
[S6] 6. columns 71-79 (9 columns) fork and variable columns: share 30-90%, 8 P, 1 S, RGP 5-35%. named 72-97% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 74, named 72%; most hesitant at column 73, 0.60 bits.
[S6.b74]    a second branch of 5 families through columns 74-78, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 29-32%, all S; the branch's families: yhcF, "YhcE family protein", yhcD, yhcA, gltF
[S6.c71]    71 variable: nanK P 90%
[S6.c72]    72 variable: nanQ P 87%
[S6.c73]    73 fork: yhcG S 50% "PDDEXK nuclease domain-containing p…"; also "IS1 family transposase" S 19%, "transposase" S 15%
[S6.c74]    74 fork: gltD P 73% "glutamate synthase subunit GltD"
[S6.c75]    75 fork: gltB P 55%
[S6.c76]    76 fork: yhcC P 49% "TIGR01212 family radical SAM protein"
[S6.c77]    77 fork: arcB P 45%
[S6.c78]    78 fork: elbB P 42%
[S6.c79]    79 fork: mtgA P 30%; also yrbL P 11%
[Q] GROUPS whose products agree, the places for a [[ ]] (name that group's columns exactly, cite its line and [Q], make one phrase from its words): columns 0-8 (rpmD to rplQ) [S1]: ribosomal; columns 24-31 (yhdZ to acrS) [S1, S2]: transporter, amino; columns 43-45 (mreB to mreD) [S3]: determining, shape, shape-determining; columns 50-53 (aaeR to aaeB) [S3]: efflux, hydroxybenzoic, p-hydroxybenzoic, pump; columns 67-72 (nanR to nanQ) [S5, S6]: acetylmannosamine, acetylneuraminate, n-acetylneuraminate.
[X] PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): rpsM 30S ribosomal protein S13; rpsK 30S ribosomal protein S11; acrF multidrug efflux RND transporter permea…; acrE multidrug efflux RND transporter peripl…; acrS multidrug efflux transporter transcript…; accC acetyl-CoA carboxylase biotin carboxyla…; mreC rod shape-determining protein MreC; mreD rod shape-determining protein MreD; aaeR HTH-type transcriptional activator AaeR; aaeA p-hydroxybenzoic acid efflux pump subun…; aaeB p-hydroxybenzoic acid efflux pump subun…; degQ serine endoprotease DegQ; zapG Z-ring associated protein ZapG; sspA stringent starvation protein SspA; nanT sialic acid transporter NanT; nanE N-acetylmannosamine-6-phosphate 2-epime…; nanK N-acetylmannosamine kinase; nanQ N-acetylneuraminate anomerase; gltD glutamate synthase subunit GltD; gltB glutamate synthase large subunit; yhcD fimbrial biogenesis usher protein; yhcA fimbria/pilus chaperone family protein; yrbL PhoP regulatory network protein YrbL
